purpose: Structured ingestion of the additional WorldClaw and Higgsfield videos. No credential or secret value is stored.

knowledge_units.content: Use coarse-to-fine decomposition: open prompt to structured regions, terrain, assets, materials and spatial relations; keep planning separate from generation; prefer editable reusable instance-level assets and render-based QA/refinement.

Large 3D generation can be compute/provider intensive. Treat it as a bounded pipeline with explicit provider selection, quotas, approval, cancellation, provenance and intermediate artifacts instead of autonomous unlimited generation.

A public repository containing credential-like values is a security incident signal, not a free capability source. Never copy or test exposed credentials. Block .env and secrets from ingestion, use secret scanning, and require owner-side rotation/revocation when exposure is confirmed.
Discovery of an endpoint, token, key or cookie does not grant authorization. Capability adoption requires an official or user-authorized credential path.

Prefer the official Higgsfield MCP endpoint and official OAuth flow. Treat networked generations as cost-bearing actions: expose provider/workflow, credit/cost implications, request boundaries and cancellation, and require explicit approval according to Tupiniquim policy.

Creative multiplication should be a bounded matrix: base creative plus selected dimensions such as character, outfit/product, location, language, hook, format, CTA and duration; preview the plan, approve the batch, generate, QA and version assets. Generation does not imply automatic Meta Ads publication or ad spend.

When an official MCP exists, prefer it over community wrappers. Reject integrations that depend on browser-cookie extraction, copied sessions or unofficial token scraping. Community implementations remain untrusted reference code until gated.

rejected_or_deferred: No WorldClaw code repository is treated as canonical until an official upstream is verified.
framepipe-dev/media-inference-worker is not synchronized because it is being used as a secret-exposure case study and public credential-like material was observed.
No exposed credential is copied, stored or tested.
No unofficial Higgsfield MCP wrapper is installed by this ingestion.
No automated paid generation or Meta Ads publication is enabled by this ingestion.
